stem: Kayla wants to provide a stronger transition between the second paragraph (sentences 4–12) and the third paragraph (sentences 13–16). Which of the following could best replace sentence 13 and accomplish this goal?

options.label: F
options.text: Some employers will be concerned about information you may have posted many years ago.

options.label: G
options.text: Be cautious as you give out information about other people, too.

options.label: H
options.text: Listen to this story about what happened to one couple.

options.label: J
options.text: There are also dangers in posting other kinds of information on social media.
